bundle.title: Let managed civic panel waves go out free, and nothing else
bundle.body:
PR 2 of 7 for the managed civic panel pilot, behind `serve-citizen-panels`.

The pilot sends each wave at GoodParty's expense, so for the first time a Serve text can reach the delivery layer without a Stripe checkout. Until now `pending` meant paid because only the SERVE_TEXT purchase claim wrote it, so nothing after checkout ever looked at payment. In peak election season, a bug that lets any other send skip payment means texts nobody paid for, at scale. This PR gives free sends one narrow way in and checks them again, independently, on the way out. It creates no waves, runs no wave job and adds no UI; PRs 3 to 6 do that.

## Guards

- **One server-only claim.** `ManagedWaveFundingService.claimFree(waveId)` is the only code that sets `Outreach.fundedBy` (null = paid, `goodparty_pilot` = free). It has no route, takes an internal wave id, and `managedWaveFunding.imports.test.ts` fails if a controller, chat tool or any file outside an explicit allowlist imports it.
- **Every condition in one locked transaction.** The wave exists and links to a send; the send is a Serve `text` in `pending_payment` with no checkout session and no funding; send and enrollment share an org; the enrollment is `building` and still has its approver; the message is exactly the approved invite; `textCount` fits in `freeTextCap - freeTextsUsed`. Then it does the SERVE_TEXT CAS claim (`pending_payment -> pending`), stamps `fundedBy` and `billableTextCount`, increments `freeTextsUsed`, and enqueues `outreachTextSend` with the same FIFO group and dedupe id. An enqueue failure reverts all of it. A wave over the cap pauses the panel.
- **`serve-citizen-panels` is the only switch.** It is read for the approving official at the claim and again at send. Off for that official, and nothing of theirs is claimed or sent free, including waves claimed while it was on. There is no env var or other config.
- **Database constraint.** A CHECK allows `fundedBy` only on a row linked to a managed wave, and never beside `stripeCheckoutSessionId`. The wave link moves onto `Outreach.managedPanelWaveId` (unique, one send per wave) so the CHECK can see both on one row; no wave row has ever been written.
- **Second gate at send time.** The `outreachTextSend` consumer and `OutreachTextDeliveryService.requestSend` refuse (ack, no CSV, no Slack handoff) any pending send that is neither paid at checkout nor a live wave of its own org whose enrollment is not stopped and whose approver is still in the flag. The claim filter repeats the database half of the rule, so a stop that lands between the check and the claim still matches nothing.
- **Nothing from the client.** No request schema takes `fundedBy` or `managedPanelWaveId`. The Win create is strict and 400s them; the Serve text, priority text and poll creates strip them; checkout metadata cannot carry them. Tests cover each route for officials inside and outside the flag, smuggling a real wave id of their own office.
- **Daily reconciliation.** `ManagedPanelFundingReconcileService` (06:47 Eastern, dev and prod, `CronLockService`) checks every Serve text, poll and expansion that moved past `pending_payment` in the last day. Each must hold a paid session or be a valid pilot wave of its own org.
- **Alerts.** A refusal at send and a reconciliation mismatch each increment `managed_panel.funding_alarm.count`, behind two new provisioned Grafana rules (usual contact point, no paging), log a CRITICAL line and post to #bot-tevyn-api. A queued pilot wave (naming the office) and a cap pause post routine notices to #bot-tevyn-api.

Every currently paid path still sends, each produced by the real purchase handler in the tests: a paid Serve text, a paid poll after staff approval, a held round 2 text after its draw, and a paid poll expansion.

Decision record: `docs/adr/2026-10-22-managed-panel-free-sends-and-guards.md`.

> [!NOTE]
> **High Risk**
> Changes payment and text-delivery invariants (who may skip checkout) with schema constraints and multiple safety layers; a bug could allow unpaid sends at scale or block legitimate pilot waves.
> 
> **Overview**
> Adds a **narrow, guarded path** for managed civic panel waves to reach Serve text delivery **without Stripe**, while blocking every other unpaid send.
> 
> **Data model:** Introduces `OutreachFunding` (`goodparty_pilot`), `Outreach.fundedBy`, and moves the wave link to `Outreach.managedPanelWaveId` with DB **CHECK** constraints so pilot funding requires a wave and cannot coexist with a checkout session.
> 
> **Internal claim:** New `ManagedWaveFundingService.claimFree` (no HTTP route) is the **only** writer of `fundedBy`; it CAS-claims `pending_payment → pending`, enforces cap/flag/invite/org rules in one transaction, enqueues send, and an **import allowlist test** blocks request-serving code from importing it.
> 
> **Defense in depth:** `OutreachTextSendFundingService` gates the queue consumer and `requestSend` before audience/CSV work; a **daily reconciliation** job scans recent sends; refusals and mismatches emit **metrics, Grafana alerts, CRITICAL logs, and Slack** to #bot-tevyn-api.
> 
> **Tests/docs:** Broad coverage for claim refusals, delivery gate, client input smuggling, and paid paths unchanged; ADR and agent docs updated.

+# Only a managed civic panel wave may skip payment, through one internal claim and a second gate at send
+
+## Decision
+
+A Serve text goes out without a Stripe checkout only when it is a managed
+civic panel wave. `Outreach.fundedBy` (null means paid, `goodparty_pilot`
+means free) is written by `ManagedWaveFundingService.claimFree` alone: no
+route, no client field, an import test that fails if anything a request
+reaches imports it, and every condition checked inside one transaction. A
+database CHECK allows `fundedBy` only on a row linked to a wave
+(`Outreach.managedPanelWaveId`, unique) and never beside a checkout session.
+The text delivery layer independently refuses any send that is neither paid
+nor a live wave, a daily job reconciles every unpaid send, and both raise a
+metric-backed Grafana alarm. `serve-citizen-panels`, read for the official
+who approved the panel, is the only switch: both the claim and the send-time
+gate refuse anything of theirs once it is off.
+
+## Context
+
+The managed pilot (`2026-10-22-managed-civic-panel-replaces-build-plan.md`)
+sends waves for free. It is peak election season, and the cost of a bug that
+lets any other send skip payment is texts nobody paid for, at scale. Until
+now `pending` meant paid because only the purchase claim could write it, so
+the delivery layer never looked at payment. The wave-to-send link moved from
+`ManagedPanelWave.outreachId` to `Outreach.managedPanelWaveId` so the CHECK
+can see the link and the funding on one row; no wave had ever been written.
+
+## Alternatives rejected
+
+- A free SERVE_TEXT purchase at zero amount through `complete-free-purchase`.
+  That route is client-reachable, so a free send would be one request away
+  from every official.
+- Trusting the claim alone. A later bug that writes `pending` some other way
+  would go out unpaid with nothing to notice; the send-time gate and the
+  reconciliation are what catch it.
+- A database trigger instead of the CHECK and link move. Harder to read and
+  to test than a column constraint on one row.
+- A separate env-var kill switch beside the flag. Two controls for one
+  rollout invites them to disagree; turning the flag off for an office stops
+  its free sends at both the claim and the send.
+
+## Revisit if
+
+The pilot ends or becomes a paid product, or a second kind of free send is
+needed; either should extend `OutreachFunding` and the gate together.

+import { readdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
+import { join, relative } from 'node:path'
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+
+// claimFree makes a send free, so who can reach it is the guard. Anything that
+// imports the service or its module could inject it, so the import graph IS
+// the access list. Add an importer here only for the wave job, never for a
+// controller, a chat tool, or a service a request reaches.
+const SRC = join(__dirname, '..')
+
+const ALLOWED_IMPORTERS = new Set([
+  'app.module.ts',
+  'managedWaveFunding/managedWaveFunding.module.ts',
+  'managedWaveFunding/managedWaveFunding.service.test.ts',
+  'outreach/tests/textSendFundingGate.test.ts',
+])
+
+const NEVER_IMPORTERS = [
+  /\.controller\.ts$/,
+  /^chats\//,
+  /^llm\//,
+  /^mcp\//,
+  /tool/i,
+]
+
+const sourceFiles = (dir: string): string[] =>
+  readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((entry) => {
+    const path = join(dir, entry.name)
+    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
+      return entry.name === 'generated' ? [] : sourceFiles(path)
+    }
+    return entry.name.endsWith('.ts') ? [path] : []
+  })
+
+const importsFunding = (source: string): boolean =>
+  /from\s+['"][^'"]*managedWaveFunding\/managedWaveFunding\.(service|module)['"]|from\s+['"]\.\/managedWaveFunding\.(service|module)['"]|import\(\s*['"][^'"]*managedWaveFunding\.(service|module)['"]/.test(
+    source,
+  )
+

+ *
+ * NO ROUTE, NO CHAT TOOL, NO WEBAPP-REACHABLE CALLER. It takes an internal
+ * wave id and is reached only from the wave job. `managedWaveFunding.imports
+ * .test.ts` fails the build if anything else imports this file.
+ */
+@Injectable()
+export class ManagedWaveFundingService extends createPrismaBase(
+  MODELS.ManagedPanelWave,
+) {
+  constructor(
+    private readonly features: FeaturesService,
+    private readonly queueProducer: QueueProducerService,
+    private readonly slack: SlackService,
+    private readonly organizations: OrganizationsService,
+  ) {
+    super()
+  }
+
+  async claimFree(waveId: string): Promise<FreeClaimResult> {
+    const result = await this.claim(waveId)
+    if (!result.claimed) {
+      this.logger.warn({ waveId, reason: result.reason }, 'Free claim refused')
+      if (result.reason === 'over_cap') await this.pauseAtCap(waveId)
+      return result
+    }
+
+    try {
+      await this.enqueueSend(result.outreachId)
+    } catch (error) {
+      // A resumed claim stays claimed, so the next attempt resumes it again
+      // rather than counting its texts a second time.
+      if (!result.resumed) {
+        await this.revert(waveId, result.outreachId, result.textCount)
+      }
+      this.logger.error(
+        { error, waveId, outreachId: result.outreachId },
+        'Free managed wave could not be enqueued; claim reverted',
+      )
+      throw error
+    }
+
+    this.logger.info(
+      { waveId, outreachId: result.outreachId, textCount: result.textCount },
+      'Free managed wave claimed and enqueued',
+    )
+    await this.notify(
+      'Managed civic panel pilot wave queued (free, no checkout)',
+      result.organizationSlug,
+      [
+        `*Outreach*: ${result.outreachId}`,
+        `*Wave*: ${waveId}`,
+        `*Recipients*: ${result.textCount}`,
+        'GoodParty is paying for this send as part of the managed civic ' +
+          'panel pilot. The recipient CSV follows as usual.',
+      ],
+    )
+    return result
+  }
+
+  private async claim(waveId: string): Promise<FreeClaimResult> {
+    const approver = await this.model.findUnique({
+      where: { id: waveId },
+      select: { enrollment: { select: { approvedByUserId: true } } },
+    })
+    if (!approver) return { claimed: false, reason: 'wave_not_found' }
+    const approvedByUserId = approver.enrollment.approvedByUserId
+    if (approvedByUserId === null) {
+      return { claimed: false, reason: 'not_approved' }
+    }
+    // The flag read is a network call, so it runs before the transaction
+    // opens; the transaction then refuses unless the approver it was read for
+    // is still the one on record.
+    const flagOn = await this.features.isFeatureEnabled({
+      user: approvedByUserId,
+      feature: SERVE_CITIZEN_PANELS_FLAG,
+    })
+    if (!flagOn) return { claimed: false, reason: 'flag_off' }
+
+    try {
+      return await this.client.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+        const wave = await tx.managedPanelWave.findUnique({
+          where: { id: waveId },
+          select: { enrollmentId: true },
+        })
+        if (!wave) throw new Refused('wave_not_found')
+        // Serializes claims on one enrollment, so two waves cannot both fit
+        // under a cap only one of them fits under, and a pause or stop waits
+        // for this claim to settle.
+        await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id FROM managed_civic_panel WHERE id = ${wave.enrollmentId} FOR UPDATE`
+
+        const enrollment = await tx.managedCivicPanel.findUniqueOrThrow({
+          where: { id: wave.enrollmentId },
+        })
+        const outreach = await tx.outreach.findUnique({
+          where: { managedPanelWaveId: waveId },
+        })
+
+        if (!outreach) throw new Refused('no_outreach')
+        // An earlier claim committed but its enqueue never happened (a crash
+        // between the two). Enqueue again: the deterministic dedupe id makes
+        // a repeat harmless, and its texts were already counted.
+        if (
+          outreach.status === OutreachStatus.pending &&
+          outreach.fundedBy === OutreachFunding.goodparty_pilot &&
+          outreach.managedPanelWaveId === waveId &&
+          outreach.organizationSlug === enrollment.organizationSlug &&
+          outreach.stripeCheckoutSessionId === null &&
+          outreach.textCount !== null &&
+          enrollment.status === ManagedCivicPanelStatus.building
+        ) {
+          return {
+            claimed: true as const,
+            outreachId: outreach.id,
+            organizationSlug: enrollment.organizationSlug,
+            textCount: outreach.textCount,
+            resumed: true,
+          }
+        }
+        if (
+          outreach.campaignId !== null ||
+          outreach.outreachType !== OutreachType.text
+        ) {
+          throw new Refused('not_serve_text')
+        }
+        if (outreach.status !== OutreachStatus.pending_payment) {
+          throw new Refused('not_pending_payment')
+        }
+        if (outreach.stripeCheckoutSessionId !== null) {
+          throw new Refused('has_checkout_session')
+        }
+        if (outreach.fundedBy !== null) throw new Refused('already_funded')
+        if (outreach.organizationSlug !== enrollment.organizationSlug) {
+          throw new Refused('wrong_org')
+        }
+        if (enrollment.status !== ManagedCivicPanelStatus.building) {
+          throw new Refused('not_building')
+        }
+        if (
+          enrollment.approvedByUserId !== approvedByUserId ||
+          !enrollment.consentVersion
+        ) {
+          throw new Refused('not_approved')
+        }
+        // Free sends carry only the words the official approved.
+        if (outreach.message !== enrollment.inviteMessage) {
+          throw new Refused('not_the_approved_invite')
+        }
+        const textCount = outreach.textCount
+        if (textCount === null || textCount < 1) {
+          throw new Refused('no_text_count')
+        }
+        if (textCount > enrollment.freeTextCap - enrollment.freeTextsUsed) {
+          throw new Refused('over_cap')
+        }
+
+        const used = await tx.managedCivicPanel.updateMany({
+          where: {
+            id: enrollment.id,
+            status: ManagedCivicPanelStatus.building,
+            freeTextsUsed: enrollment.freeTextsUsed,
+          },
+          data: { freeTextsUsed: { increment: textCount } },
+        })
+        // The same compare-and-swap the SERVE_TEXT purchase claim makes,
+        // narrowed to the facts checked above so a write between the read
+        // and here matches nothing.
+        const claimed = await tx.outreach.updateMany({
+          where: {
+            id: outreach.id,
+            managedPanelWaveId: waveId,
+            organizationSlug: enrollment.organizationSlug,
+            campaignId: null,
+            outreachType: OutreachType.text,
+            status: OutreachStatus.pending_payment,
+            stripeCheckoutSessionId: null,
+            fundedBy: null,
+          },
+          data: {
+            status: OutreachStatus.pending,
+            fundedBy: OutreachFunding.goodparty_pilot,
+            billableTextCount: textCount,
+          },
+        })
+        if (used.count !== 1 || claimed.count !== 1) {
+          throw new Refused('lost_race')
+        }
+        return {
+          claimed: true as const,
+          outreachId: outreach.id,
+          organizationSlug: enrollment.organizationSlug,
+          textCount,
+          resumed: false,
+        }
+      })
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error instanceof Refused) {
+        return { claimed: false, reason: error.reason }
+      }
+      throw error
+    }
+  }
+
+  // Undoes the claim in one write so the wave can be claimed again: the row
+  // back to an unfunded draft and its texts back under the cap. Guarded on
+  // the claim's own state, so it can never clobber a later move.
+  private async revert(
+    waveId: string,
+    outreachId: number,
+    textCount: number,
+  ): Promise<void> {
+    await this.client.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+      const wave = await tx.managedPanelWave.findUnique({
+        where: { id: waveId },
+        select: { enrollmentId: true },
+      })
+      if (!wave) return
+      // Same lock order as the claim, so a claim on this enrollment waits
+      // for the whole revert rather than interleaving with it.
+      await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id FROM managed_civic_panel WHERE id = ${wave.enrollmentId} FOR UPDATE`
+      const reverted = await tx.outreach.updateMany({
+        where: {
+          id: outreachId,
+          managedPanelWaveId: waveId,
+          status: OutreachStatus.pending,
+          fundedBy: OutreachFunding.goodparty_pilot,
+        },
+        data: {
+          status: OutreachStatus.pending_payment,
+          fundedBy: null,
+          billableTextCount: null,
+        },
+      })
+      if (reverted.count === 0) return
+      await tx.managedCivicPanel.updateMany({
+        where: { id: wave.enrollmentId },
+        data: { freeTextsUsed: { decrement: textCount } },
+      })
+    })
+  }
+
+  private async enqueueSend(outreachId: number): Promise<void> {
+    await this.queueProducer.sendMessage(
+      {
+        type: QueueType.OUTREACH_TEXT_SEND,
+        data: { outreachId, sendSeq: INITIAL_SEND_SEQ },
+      },
+      `${MessageGroup.outreachTextSend}-${outreachId}`,
+      {
+        throwOnError: true,
+        deduplicationId: `${QueueType.OUTREACH_TEXT_SEND}-${outreachId}-${INITIAL_SEND_SEQ}`,
+      },
+    )
+  }
+
+  // A wave that does not fit what is left of the cap pauses the build, so
+  // nothing keeps drawing waves that can never be claimed free. Staff decide
+  // whether to raise the cap.
+  private async pauseAtCap(waveId: string): Promise<void> {
+    // Re-checked under the claim's lock: a sibling claim reverted since the
+    // refusal may have handed texts back, and then the wave fits after all.
+    const paused = await this.client.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+      const wave = await tx.managedPanelWave.findUnique({
+        where: { id: waveId },
+        select: {
+          enrollmentId: true,
+          outreach: { select: { textCount: true } },
+        },
+      })
+      if (!wave) return null
+      await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id FROM managed_civic_panel WHERE id = ${wave.enrollmentId} FOR UPDATE`
+      const enrollment = await tx.managedCivicPanel.findUniqueOrThrow({
+        where: { id: wave.enrollmentId },
+      })
+      const textCount = wave.outreach?.textCount ?? 0
+      if (
+        enrollment.status !== ManagedCivicPanelStatus.building ||
+        textCount <= enrollment.freeTextCap - enrollment.freeTextsUsed
+      ) {
+        return null
+      }
+      await tx.managedCivicPanel.update({
+        where: { id: enrollment.id },
+        data: { status: ManagedCivicPanelStatus.paused, pausedAt: new Date() },
+      })
+      return enrollment
+    })
+    if (!paused) return
+    this.logger.warn(
+      { waveId, organizationSlug: paused.organizationSlug },
+      'Managed civic panel paused at its free text cap',
+    )
+    await this.notify(
+      'Managed civic panel paused at its free text cap',
+      paused.organizationSlug,
+      [
+        `*Free texts used*: ${paused.freeTextsUsed} of ${paused.freeTextCap}`,
+        `*Wave*: ${waveId} did not fit and was not sent`,
+      ],
+    )
+  }
+
+  // Routine notices for staff. A failure here never undoes a claim that has
+  // already been enqueued.
+  private async notify(
+    header: string,
+    organizationSlug: string,
+    lines: string[],
+  ): Promise<void> {
+    try {
+      const office = await this.organizations
+        .resolvePositionNameByOrganizationSlug(organizationSlug)
+        .catch(() => null)
+      await this.slack.message(
+        {
+          blocks: [
+            {
+              type: SlackMessageType.HEADER,
+              text: {
+                type: SlackMessageType.PLAIN_TEXT,
+                text: header,
+                emoji: true,
+              },
+            },
+            {
+              type: SlackMessageType.SECTION,
+              text: {
+                type: SlackMessageType.MRKDWN,
+                text: [
+                  `*Office*: ${office ?? 'unknown'} (${organizationSlug})`,
+                  ...lines,
+                ].join('\n'),
+              },
+            },
+          ],
+        },
+        SlackChannel.botTevynApi,
+      )
+    } catch (err) {
+      this.logger.error({ err, header }, 'Managed panel notice failed')
+    }
+  }
+}

+import { Logger } from '@nestjs/common'
+import { metrics } from '@opentelemetry/api'
+
+// The two managed panel free-send safety alarms, as one counter the
+// `serve-managed-panel-*` Grafana rules read. Same meter pattern as
+// person-profiles.metrics.ts: no-op without OTLP export, and a record can
+// never break the caller.
+const logger = new Logger('ManagedPanelFundingMetrics')
+
+const isOtelEnabled = (): boolean =>
+  Boolean(process.env.OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS)
+
+const environment = (): string =>
+  process.env.OTEL_SERVICE_ENVIRONMENT || 'local'
+
+// Prometheus (via Grafana Cloud OTLP) exposes this as
+// managed_panel_funding_alarm_count_total{kind=...}.
+export const MANAGED_PANEL_FUNDING_ALARM_METRIC =
+  'managed_panel_funding_alarm_count_total'
+
+const alarmCounter = metrics
+  .getMeter('gp-api')
+  .createCounter('managed_panel.funding_alarm.count', {
+    description:
+      'Serve text sends refused for lack of funding, and reconciliation ' +
+      'mismatches, by kind',
+  })
+
+/**
+ * - send_refused:       a text reached the delivery layer with neither a paid
+ *                       checkout nor a valid managed wave, and was not sent
+ * - reconcile_mismatch: the daily reconciliation found a send past `pending`
+ *                       with neither
+ */
+export type ManagedPanelFundingAlarm = 'send_refused' | 'reconcile_mismatch'
+
+const ALARMS: ManagedPanelFundingAlarm[] = [
+  'send_refused',
+  'reconcile_mismatch',
+]
+
+// Prometheus `increase()` cannot see the first sample of a new series, so an
+// alarm whose series first appears with the event would never fire. Writing a
+// zero at boot gives every series a baseline the first real event rises from.
+if (isOtelEnabled()) {
+  for (const kind of ALARMS) {
+    alarmCounter.add(0, { kind, environment: environment() })
+  }
+}
+
+export const recordManagedPanelFundingAlarm = (
+  kind: ManagedPanelFundingAlarm,
+  count = 1,
+): void => {
+  if (!isOtelEnabled()) return
+  try {
+    alarmCounter.add(count, { kind, environment: environment() })
+  } catch (error) {
+    logger.error('Failed to record managed panel funding alarm', error)
+  }
+}

+import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common'
+import { Cron } from '@nestjs/schedule'
+import { subHours } from 'date-fns'
+import { CronLockService } from '@/cron/services/cronLock.service'
+import {
+  OutreachFunding,
+  OutreachStatus,
+  OutreachType,
+} from '@/generated/prisma'
+import { createPrismaBase, MODELS } from '@/prisma/util/prisma.util'
+import { EASTERN_TIMEZONE } from '@/shared/util/date.util'
+import { SlackService } from '@/vendors/slack/services/slack.service'
+import {
+  SlackChannel,
+  SlackMessageType,
+} from '@/vendors/slack/slackService.types'
+import { recordManagedPanelFundingAlarm } from '../observability/managedPanelFunding.metrics'
+
+const RECONCILE_CRON = '47 6 * * *'
+export const MANAGED_PANEL_FUNDING_RECONCILE_JOB =
+  'managedPanelFundingReconcile'
+const WINDOW_HOURS = 24
+// A claimed pilot wave is handed off within seconds of its enqueue; one still
+// `pending` this long lost its queue message and will never send on its own.
+const STUCK_PILOT_HOURS = 4
+
+// Prod is what the job protects, and dev is where a mismatch shows up first.
+// Not previews: every PR stack would post the same finding at once.
+const RECONCILE_DEPLOY_ENVIRONMENTS = new Set(['dev', 'prod'])
+
+// The `serve-managed-panel-funding-mismatch` alert message tells the
+// responder to search for this line. Change both together.
+export const FUNDING_MISMATCH_LOG =
+  'CRITICAL managed panel funding: send past pending with no funding'
+
+// Every status a send reaches once it has been claimed for sending.
+const CLAIMED_STATUSES = [
+  OutreachStatus.pending,
+  OutreachStatus.approved,
+  OutreachStatus.paid,
+  OutreachStatus.in_progress,
+  OutreachStatus.completed,
+  OutreachStatus.failed,
+]
+
+export type FundingMismatch = {
+  outreachId: number
+  sendSeq: number
+  organizationSlug: string | null
+  status: OutreachStatus
+  // unfunded: no paid checkout and no valid managed wave. stuck: a valid
+  // pilot wave claimed hours ago that never reached the delivery layer.
+  problem: 'unfunded' | 'stuck'
+}
+
+/**
+ * The daily backstop on free sends. Every Serve text or poll send that moved
+ * past `pending_payment` in the last day must hold a paid checkout session or
+ * be a managed civic panel wave of its own organization funded by the pilot.
+ * Anything else is a send that skipped payment, and raises the alarm. Read
+ * only: it never changes a row.
+ */
+@Injectable()
+export class ManagedPanelFundingReconcileService extends createPrismaBase(
+  MODELS.Outreach,
+) {
+  constructor(
+    private readonly cronLock: CronLockService,
+    private readonly slack: SlackService,
+  ) {
+    super()
+  }
+
+  @Cron(RECONCILE_CRON, {
+    name: MANAGED_PANEL_FUNDING_RECONCILE_JOB,
+    timeZone: EASTERN_TIMEZONE,
+  })
+  async reconcileDaily(): Promise<void> {
+    if (
+      !RECONCILE_DEPLOY_ENVIRONMENTS.has(
+        process.env.OTEL_SERVICE_ENVIRONMENT ?? '',
+      )
+    ) {
+      return
+    }
+    const now = new Date()
+    if (
+      !(await this.cronLock.tryClaimDailyRun(
+        MANAGED_PANEL_FUNDING_RECONCILE_JOB,
+        now,
+      ))
+    ) {
+      return
+    }
+    try {
+      await this.reconcile(now)
+    } finally {
+      await this.cronLock.markCompleted(
+        MANAGED_PANEL_FUNDING_RECONCILE_JOB,
+        now,
+      )
+    }
+  }
+
+  async reconcile(now: Date = new Date()): Promise<FundingMismatch[]> {
+    const since = subHours(now, WINDOW_HOURS)
+
+    const unpaidSends = await this.model.findMany({
+      where: {
+        campaignId: null,
+        outreachType: { in: [OutreachType.text, OutreachType.poll] },
+        status: { in: CLAIMED_STATUSES },
+        updatedAt: { gte: since },
+        stripeCheckoutSessionId: null,
+      },
+      select: {
+        id: true,
+        organizationSlug: true,
+        outreachType: true,
+        status: true,
+        fundedBy: true,
+        managedPanelWave: {
+          select: { enrollment: { select: { organizationSlug: true } } },
+        },
+      },
+    })
+    const stuckPilotSends = await this.model.findMany({
+      where: {
+        fundedBy: OutreachFunding.goodparty_pilot,
+        status: OutreachStatus.pending,
+        updatedAt: { lt: subHours(now, STUCK_PILOT_HOURS) },
+      },
+      select: { id: true, organizationSlug: true },
+    })
+    const unpaidExpansions = await this.client.outreachPollExpansion.findMany({
+      where: {
+        status: { in: CLAIMED_STATUSES },
+        stripeCheckoutSessionId: null,
+        OR: [{ createdAt: { gte: since } }, { approvedAt: { gte: since } }],
+      },
+      select: {
+        outreachId: true,
+        sendSeq: true,
+        status: true,
+        poll: { select: { outreach: { select: { organizationSlug: true } } } },
+      },
+    })
+
+    const unfunded = unpaidSends
+      .filter(
+        (row) =>
+          !(
+            row.fundedBy === OutreachFunding.goodparty_pilot &&
+            row.outreachType === OutreachType.text &&
+            row.organizationSlug !== null &&
+            row.managedPanelWave?.enrollment.organizationSlug ===
+              row.organizationSlug
+          ),
+      )
+      .map((row) => ({
+        outreachId: row.id,
+        sendSeq: 1,
+        organizationSlug: row.organizationSlug,
+        status: row.status ?? OutreachStatus.pending,
+        problem: 'unfunded' as const,
+      }))
+    // A send that is both is reported once, as unfunded: whether it may go
+    // out free at all comes before whether its queue message was lost.
+    const unfundedIds = new Set(unfunded.map((m) => m.outreachId))
+    const mismatches: FundingMismatch[] = [
+      ...unfunded,
+      ...stuckPilotSends
+        .filter((row) => !unfundedIds.has(row.id))
+        .map((row) => ({
+          outreachId: row.id,
+          sendSeq: 1,
+          organizationSlug: row.organizationSlug,
+          status: OutreachStatus.pending,
+          problem: 'stuck' as const,
+        })),
+      ...unpaidExpansions.map((expansion) => ({
+        outreachId: expansion.outreachId,
+        sendSeq: expansion.sendSeq,
+        organizationSlug: expansion.poll.outreach.organizationSlug,
+        status: expansion.status,
+        problem: 'unfunded' as const,
+      })),
+    ]
+
+    if (mismatches.length === 0) {
+      this.logger.info(
+        { since, checked: unpaidSends.length + unpaidExpansions.length },
+        'Managed panel funding reconciled: every unpaid send is a valid ' +
+          'managed wave',
+      )
+      return mismatches
+    }
+
+    recordManagedPanelFundingAlarm('reconcile_mismatch', mismatches.length)
+    this.logger.error({ since, mismatches }, FUNDING_MISMATCH_LOG)
+    await this.notify(mismatches)
+    return mismatches
+  }
+
+  private async notify(mismatches: FundingMismatch[]): Promise<void> {
+    try {
+      await this.slack.message(
+        {
+          blocks: [
+            {
+              type: SlackMessageType.HEADER,
+              text: {
+                type: SlackMessageType.PLAIN_TEXT,
+                text: 'Text sends with no funding, or stuck pilot waves',
+                emoji: true,
+              },
+            },
+            {
+              type: SlackMessageType.SECTION,
+              text: {
+                type: SlackMessageType.MRKDWN,
+                text: [
+                  'Unfunded: moved past checkout in the last day with ' +
+                    'neither a paid checkout nor a managed civic panel wave. ' +
+                    'Stuck: a pilot wave still waiting to send after ' +
+                    `${STUCK_PILOT_HOURS} hours; re-run its claim to enqueue it.`,
+                  ...mismatches.map(
+                    (m) =>
+                      `• Outreach ${m.outreachId}, send ${m.sendSeq} ` +
+                      `(${m.organizationSlug ?? 'no org'}, ${m.status}, ` +
+                      `${m.problem})`,
+                  ),
+                ].join('\n'),
+              },
+            },
+          ],
+        },
+        SlackChannel.botTevynApi,
+      )
+    } catch (err) {
+      this.logger.error({ err }, 'Funding mismatch notice failed')
+    }
+  }
+}

+import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common'
+import {
+  ManagedCivicPanelStatus,
+  OutreachFunding,
+  OutreachStatus,
+  OutreachType,
+  Prisma,
+} from '@/generated/prisma'
+import { FeaturesService } from '@/features/services/features.service'
+import { createPrismaBase, MODELS } from '@/prisma/util/prisma.util'
+import { SERVE_CITIZEN_PANELS_FLAG } from '@/shared/util/serveCitizenPanelsFlag.util'
+import { SlackService } from '@/vendors/slack/services/slack.service'
+import {
+  SlackChannel,
+  SlackMessageType,
+} from '@/vendors/slack/slackService.types'
+import { recordManagedPanelFundingAlarm } from '../observability/managedPanelFunding.metrics'
+
+const FIRST_SEND_SEQ = 1
+
+// The `serve-managed-panel-unfunded-send-refused` alert message tells the
+// responder to search for this line. Change both together.
+export const UNFUNDED_SEND_REFUSED_LOG =
+  'CRITICAL managed panel funding: unfunded text send refused'
+
+export type TextSendUnfundedReason =
+  | 'unpaid'
+  | 'flag_off'
+  | 'no_managed_wave'
+  | 'not_serve_text'
+  | 'wrong_org'
+  | 'enrollment_stopped'
+  | 'unpaid_expansion'
+  // Missing, or not `pending`: the delivery claim refuses it anyway, so it
+  // is not a funding question and raises no alarm.
+  | 'not_sendable'
+
+export type TextSendFunding =
+  | { funded: true; via: 'checkout' | 'managed_pilot' }
+  | { funded: false; reason: TextSendUnfundedReason }
+
+/**
+ * What a text send may claim from, as a filter the delivery layer adds to its
+ * own `pending -> in_progress` claim: paid at checkout, or a free managed
+ * wave whose enrollment is not stopped. The org match and the approver's
+ * flag cannot be written as a filter; `check` holds that half.
+ */
+export const fundedTextSendWhere = (): Prisma.OutreachWhereInput => ({
+  OR: [
+    { stripeCheckoutSessionId: { not: null } },
+    {
+      fundedBy: OutreachFunding.goodparty_pilot,
+      campaignId: null,
+      outreachType: OutreachType.text,
+      managedPanelWave: {
+        is: {
+          enrollment: { status: { not: ManagedCivicPanelStatus.stopped } },
+        },
+      },
+    },
+  ],
+})
+
+/**
+ * The second gate on free sends, at the last moment before a human gets the
+ * recipient CSV. A text goes out only if it was paid for at checkout or is a
+ * live managed civic panel wave; everything else is refused, counted on the
+ * funding alarm metric, logged at CRITICAL and posted to staff.
+ *
+ * Every Serve text, poll and round 2 row reaches `pending` through the
+ * SERVE_TEXT purchase claim, which stamps the checkout session, and an
+ * expansion stamps its own. A Serve text can never price at zero (a row with
+ * no recipient count is refused at checkout), so the free-purchase path never
+ * reaches one, and no legitimate send arrives here with neither.
+ */
+@Injectable()
+export class OutreachTextSendFundingService extends createPrismaBase(
+  MODELS.Outreach,
+) {
+  constructor(
+    private readonly slack: SlackService,
+    private readonly features: FeaturesService,
+  ) {
+    super()
+  }
+
+  async check(outreachId: number, sendSeq: number): Promise<TextSendFunding> {
+    if (sendSeq > FIRST_SEND_SEQ) {
+      const expansion = await this.client.outreachPollExpansion.findFirst({
+        where: { outreachId, sendSeq },
+        select: { status: true, stripeCheckoutSessionId: true },
+      })
+      if (expansion?.status !== OutreachStatus.pending) {
+        return { funded: false, reason: 'not_sendable' }
+      }
+      return expansion.stripeCheckoutSessionId
+        ? { funded: true, via: 'checkout' }
+        : { funded: false, reason: 'unpaid_expansion' }
+    }
+
+    const row = await this.model.findUnique({
+      where: { id: outreachId },
+      select: {
+        campaignId: true,
+        organizationSlug: true,
+        outreachType: true,
+        status: true,
+        stripeCheckoutSessionId: true,
+        fundedBy: true,
+        managedPanelWave: {
+          select: {
+            enrollment: {
+              select: {
+                organizationSlug: true,
+                status: true,
+                approvedByUserId: true,
+              },
+            },
+          },
+        },
+      },
+    })
+    if (row?.status !== OutreachStatus.pending) {
+      return { funded: false, reason: 'not_sendable' }
+    }
+    if (row.stripeCheckoutSessionId) return { funded: true, via: 'checkout' }
+    if (row.fundedBy !== OutreachFunding.goodparty_pilot) {
+      return { funded: false, reason: 'unpaid' }
+    }
+    const enrollment = row.managedPanelWave?.enrollment
+    if (!enrollment) return { funded: false, reason: 'no_managed_wave' }
+    if (row.campaignId !== null || row.outreachType !== OutreachType.text) {
+      return { funded: false, reason: 'not_serve_text' }
+    }
+    if (enrollment.organizationSlug !== row.organizationSlug) {
+      return { funded: false, reason: 'wrong_org' }
+    }
+    if (enrollment.status === ManagedCivicPanelStatus.stopped) {
+      return { funded: false, reason: 'enrollment_stopped' }
+    }
+    // serve-citizen-panels is the only switch on free sends: off for the
+    // official who approved the panel, and nothing of theirs goes out free.
+    const flagOn =
+      enrollment.approvedByUserId !== null &&
+      (await this.features.isFeatureEnabled({
+        user: enrollment.approvedByUserId,
+        feature: SERVE_CITIZEN_PANELS_FLAG,
+      }))
+    if (!flagOn) return { funded: false, reason: 'flag_off' }
+    return { funded: true, via: 'managed_pilot' }
+  }
+
+  async reportRefusal(
+    outreachId: number,
+    sendSeq: number,
+    reason: TextSendUnfundedReason,
+  ): Promise<void> {
+    recordManagedPanelFundingAlarm('send_refused')
+    this.logger.error(
+      { outreachId, sendSeq, reason },
+      UNFUNDED_SEND_REFUSED_LOG,
+    )
+    try {
+      await this.slack.message(
+        {
+          blocks: [
+            {
+              type: SlackMessageType.HEADER,
+              text: {
+                type: SlackMessageType.PLAIN_TEXT,
+                text: 'Unfunded text send refused',
+                emoji: true,
+              },
+            },
+            {
+              type: SlackMessageType.SECTION,
+              text: {
+                type: SlackMessageType.MRKDWN,
+                text:
+                  `*Outreach*: ${outreachId}, send ${sendSeq}` +
+                  `\n*Reason*: ${reason}` +
+                  '\nNothing was handed off. It was neither paid at ' +
+                  'checkout nor a live managed civic panel wave.',
+              },
+            },
+          ],
+        },
+        SlackChannel.botTevynApi,
+      )
+    } catch (err) {
+      this.logger.error(
+        { err, outreachId, sendSeq },
+        'Unfunded send refusal notice failed',
+      )
+    }
+  }
+}

findings.body: The `unpaidSends` query filters on `updatedAt: { gte: since }` (a 24-hour rolling window). A non-pilot unfunded send that somehow bypasses the primary checkout gate and then receives no further writes will be caught on the first reconciliation run after creation, but silently falls out of the window on subsequent runs. The `stuckPilotSends` query (line 127-134) provides a permanent backstop for `fundedBy: goodparty_pilot` rows (no upper age bound), but there is no equivalent permanent backstop for non-pilot unfunded sends. Contrast with `unpaidExpansions` (line 139) which uses `createdAt` / `approvedAt` — a similar approach here would keep non-pilot unfunded sends visible across runs. This is a defense-in-depth gap, not a primary-gate bypass: a non-pilot send must first bypass checkout to be unfunded. Falsification check: no periodic writer refreshes `updatedAt` on stuck unfunded Outreach rows (grepped for update patterns targeting this case and found none), and the `stuckPilotSends` query covers only `goodparty_pilot`-funded rows.
